raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Enable chunked prefill for DSV4 (DeepSeek-V4) on Ascend NPU, so long prompts are prefilled in fixed-size chunks instead of one extend — bounding peak memory and compressor-state growth for long context. ## Modifications Route chunked prefill (batches with `extend_prefix_lens > 0`) through the fused compressor op (`cache_mode=1`), which handles c4 cross-chunk overlap in-kernel; non-chunked prefill and decode are unchanged. Add the matching fused prefill metadata (`start_pos`, block-aligned `positions_cmp`, cumulative state page tables) and make the c4/c128 compress-state pool chunked-aware with per-chunk incremental allocation + eviction to preserve cross-chunk tails and avoid state-pool OOM. ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling ## Checklist - [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #28489089382](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/28489089382) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #28489089275](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/28489089275)
